reasoning: Round 2: both round-1 findings are applied in tasks.md (2.1 node ids, 1.1 setup/test continue-on-error and if). Every class is ok, and the design stays observed and traced.

simpler.evidence: Simpler: a dual-mode reusable-quality.yml (design D1), which the person rejected on 2026-09-23. Also simpler: the callee and template alone, with no publisher caller. That is rejected by scenario 'Publisher PR' and by the Goal that a caller reports on main for issue 154. The NOT_REQUIRED entry (D5) is forced by the existing real-workflow test at tests/agent_process/test_branch_protection.py:545. The publisher's unmarked .github/workflows/agent-process.yml sits at init.py's managed path (init.py:97). If init runs on this repo, it prints a visible conflict and does not overwrite the file (archived v2-2g-b D4), so this is not a silent failure.

map.evidence: Consumer test fails -> test_quality_callee_runs_the_callers_commands. This is structural: `test` has no if or continue-on-error, and the run is bash -e. Consumer render -> test_caller_inputs. Publisher PR -> test_publisher_caller_reaches_callee_by_same_commit_path, which proves the ./ path and the ci_check.py command. Same-commit resolution is platform behaviour, covered by the reuse-workflows doc quote and this PR's own run ids (task 4.2). All 3 scenarios are mapped.

red.evidence: Group 1 has tasks 1.1-1.2 plus check_red.py (1.3). Each new or extended test fails in its body while quality.yml and agent-process.yml are absent. Task 2.1 now verifies only test_quality_callee_runs_the_callers_commands and test_callees_declare_workflow_call_without_pull_request_trigger, and both read only quality.yml, which 2.1 adds. The schema, permission and publisher-caller tests read agent-process.yml and turn green in 2.2's full-file run.

platform.evidence: The ./ path resolving from the same commit: reuse-workflows doc sentence (design Observations). A run using the event commit's workflow version: workflows doc sentence. A caller present on 'opened' reporting without close/reopen: probe PR 1 runs 35909173919/35909173945 and PR 2 runs 35909442544/35909442456. A check name composed as '<caller job> / <callee job>': the same probe runs. A merge through a strict ruleset with an extra non-required check: probe merge cccc48a, mergeStateStatus CLEAN. Zero jobs when a caller passes inputs the @main callee does not declare: PR 151 run 35523639249. The live required set is read back by task 3.3. Every behaviour has an observation.

replaced.evidence: Publisher: nothing is replaced. The new context runs the PR's own ci_check.py, and D3 'Trust boundary' lists what that proof stops covering, with its catcher. Consumer: moving the template onto caller-supplied setup/test (dropping the trusted default-branch driver and the feature-detected product install) was listed in archived v2-2g-b D5, with a catcher per failure mode. D2 renames that design's typo catcher from the consumer's 'quality / quality' run to 'agent-process / quality'. It is the same run under a new name, so it is still reached.

catcher.evidence: D3's lost proof (PR-controlled ci_check.py) is caught by required 'quality / quality'. ci.yml runs on every pull_request, reusable-quality.yml@main runs the default-branch ci_check.py against the PR worktree, and ruleset 23732345 requires it strict on the same head (task 3.3 reads this back). D5's completeness is proven by test_branch_protection.py:545 inside ci_check.py, which that same required run reaches. v1 byte-identity is checked by the git diff in task 3.2. Callee interface drift is caught by the schema-pair test (1.1) plus test_caller_inputs' with-keys check (test_init.py:806). All catchers are traced.

length.evidence: Words in spec sentences (words asserted by tests): 'quality.yml SHALL take an optional setup and a required test...' 17 (17). 'Its one job quality SHALL first verify...on the PR's checkout' 27 (27). 'A failing command SHALL fail the job' 7 (7): 1.1 now asserts that setup's only if is inputs.setup != '', that test has no if, and that neither step has continue-on-error. 'A caller job...SHALL be named agent-process, so the check reports as agent-process / quality' 17 (9; the composed name comes from probe runs). 'A consumer caller SHALL call it at an immutable release tag' 12 (12). 'The publisher caller SHALL call it by a same-repository ./ path, which takes caller and callee from the same commit' 20 (11; same-commit comes from the doc quote). No rule or doc prose is added.

bespoke.evidence: Added quality.yml: closes PR 151 run 35523639249 (zero jobs) and issue 153. Added agent-process.yml: gives issue 154 the observed context that it preflights on (issue 153 acceptance). The NOT_REQUIRED entry: required by the existing guard test, with no new check. No new script or checker is added.
